title: Rising ozone pollution as a threat to wheat yield in India: insights from a concentration-based approach
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00850F, Paper
K. S. Anagha, Jayanarayanan Kuttippurath
Safeguarding food security requires sustained air and crop monitoring, crop-specific ozone tolerance research, and integrated strategies aligning agricultural and air quality policies amid climate change and rising air pollution.
